paragraphs.text: The following Echoverse characters are mentioned in flavor text or on legendary creature cards, appear as minor characters in the storyline , or are otherwise not notable enough to receive their own article.

The Founder Sphinx of Hexhaven 's Konstrari school. The sphinx was created at Arcavios's largest leyline confluence by the harmonious alignment of Echoverse Arcavios's mana. They mastered the ability to animate inert materials by condensing leyline energy into a heartwood crystal. With the other four sphinxes, they helped found Hexhaven, sharing their knowledge of magic with the plane's denizens to protect them from the turbulent world. They founded Konstrari with three guiding tenets: "embrace the heart (bravery) and trust the soul (insight)"; "lead with instinct and imagination"; and "creativity grows from emotion". Though they still serve as Konstrari's dean, they have become aloof, more focused on their legacy than the Academy's day-to-day operations.

The Founder Sphinx of Hexhaven 's Fatehold school. The sphinx was created at Arcavios's largest leyline confluence by the harmonious alignment of Echoverse Arcavios's mana. With the other four sphinxes, he helped found Hexhaven, sharing his knowledge of magic with the plane's denizens to protect them from the turbulent world. He founded Fatehold with three guiding principles: "the future is a cautionary tale and a model for the present"; "predict what can happen, then influence a component of that future to direct the course of history"; and "use the power of future knowledge for the betterment of all". Though he still serves as Fatehold's dean, he has become aloof, more focused on his legacy than the Academy's day-to-day operations.

The Founder Sphinx of Hexhaven 's Stingerquill school. The sphinx was created at Arcavios's largest leyline confluence by the harmonious alignment of Echoverse Arcavios's mana. With the other four sphinxes, she helped found Hexhaven, sharing her knowledge of magic with the plane's denizens to protect them from the turbulent world. She founded Stingerquill with three guiding principles: "have the last word—at any cost"; "quick wit will win"; and "an opponent's heartbeat betrays their fears and doubts. Speak and hold power over them". Though she still serves as Stingerquill's dean, she has become aloof, more focused on her legacy than the Academy's day-to-day operations.

The Founder Sphinx of Hexhaven 's Vigorbloom school. She emerged from the leyline confluence with the ability to grow and manipulate plant matter. With the other four sphinxes, she helped found Hexhaven, sharing her knowledge of magic with the plane's denizens to protect them from the turbulent world. She founded Vigorbloom with three guiding oaths: "I will serve a higher purpose than myself"; "I will grow, heal, and strengthen the community"; and "I will ensure survival of the community through healing by any means necessary". Though she still serves as Vigorbloom's dean, she has become aloof, more focused on her legacy than the Academy's day-to-day operations.

The Founder Sphinx of Hexhaven 's Theorix school. The sphinx was created at Arcavios's largest leyline confluence by the harmonious alignment of Echoverse Arcavios's mana. He used his reality-bending magic to build the original fortress of Hexhaven, keeping the campus out of reach of the mage hunters . With the other four sphinxes, he helped found Hexhaven, sharing his knowledge of magic with the plane's denizens to protect them from the turbulent world. Seeking students who demonstrated a thirst for knowledge and a capacity for abstract thought, he founded Theorix and established three magical laws: "reality cannot be created or destroyed without sacrifice"; "leyline energy is a multiversal constant"; and "the dimensions of reality are defined by the minimum number of points in contact with the Blind Eternities". Though he still serves as Theorix's dean, he has become aloof, more focused on his legacy than the Academy's day-to-day operations.

While the five Founder Sphinxes act as the overarching deans of the individual schools, the daily, on-the-ground management of the academy is explicitly left to a collective group consisting of its professors, its provost, and the campus headmaster.

In the Echoverse , Josu Vess never died, allowing his sister Liliana to continue her studies in Benalia as a healer. Her Planeswalker spark never ignited. She works as a professor in Hexhaven on Arcavios under the alias "Professor Opal". She has a cloying, saccharine demeanor. Tamira notes that her Hexhaven office always smells of lavender.

In the Echoverse, Ral Zarek is a black -aligned Orzhov lawmage. He retains his planeswalker spark and his blue-gray eyes and black-streaked white hair, but sports a mustache and goatee. Zarek wears black, white, and gold. When he planeswalks, he vanishes in a swirl of shadow dotted with bursts of light.
The Ur-Sphinx is an alternate version of the Ur-Dragon in the Echoverse .

The Ur-Sphinx's blood and magic courses through every sphinx in the Multiverse . Vain and prideful, the Ur-Sphinx creates each of its offspring with deliberate intention, manifesting them purely from its thoughts. It is said that the elder sphinx founders of Hexhaven are the Ur-Sphinx's most favored creations, each created to embody core aspects of the Ur-Sphinx's psyche. These elder sphinxes are the closest things the godlike sphinx has to children, and it shares a telepathic bond with them that allows the elder sphinxes to communicate with their creator anywhere in the Echoverse. As a powerful telepath, the Ur-Sphinx is second only to Jace , with the ability to erase memories, cause hallucinations, and exert mind control on entire cities with little effort.

The following Echoverse characters are only mentioned in flavor text or have small blurbs in "The Legends of Reality Fracture " article. Following the death of The Theorist and Emrakul 's assault on the Echoverse, all characters listed here are presumed deceased.
